versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Create Business Plan skill—a universal methodology for drafting business plans across any new product category.

- Provides a comprehensive, cross-category workflow and mandatory principles for all business plan (BP) tasks.
- Enforces rigorous data integrity labeling and validates all assumptions with explicit evidence or verification plans.
- Includes step-by-step methodology covering intake, research, evaluation, assumption validation, revision with approval, visual assets generation, feedback, and optional knowledge documentation.
- Supports collaborative editing, both offline (PPTX/DOCX) and via cloud documents with guidelines for syncing changes.
- Standardizes terminology and requires an included metrics glossary for clarity and consistency.
- No content tied to any specific brand, product, or company; all examples are illustrative only.
